data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Laurentum', meaning 'the shining one from Laurentum'. Laurentum is an ancient Roman name for a coastal region in Italy. in_hebrew.name: לורנציאן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לורנציאן הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו עוצמה מן הכור הלאור הצלה. השם לורנציאן נגזר מהמילה הלורנציונית שפירושה כור הלאור. לאור הינו סמל לנצרות המוקדמת והוא מייצג את ישו המשיח. השם לורנציאן משמש לעתים קרובות כסמל להגנה ולשמירה מפני הרוע.

in_greek.name: Λαυρεντιάνος
in_greek.long_meaning: Λαυρεντιάνος είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το Λατινικό και σημαίνει φωτεινός σανιδωτός. Το όνομα Λαυρεντιάνος προέρχεται από τη λέξη Λαυρέντιος που σημαίνει αυτός που φέρει το δάφνη, ένα σύμβολο νίκης και τιμής. Στην πρώιμη χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Λαυρεντιάνος συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Λαυρέντιο, έναν μάρτυρα που θυσιάστηκε για την πίστη του.

in_latin.name: Laurentianus
in_latin.long_meaning: Laurentianus est nomen christianum quod originem habet in lingua Latina et significat laurus coronatus. Nomen Laurentianus derivatur a voce Laurentianus quae significat laurus, symbolum victoriae et honoris. In traditione christiana antiqua, nomen Laurentianus coniungitur cum Sancto Laurentio, martyre qui pro fide sua sacrificatus est.

in_english.name: Laurentian
in_english.meaning: Derived from laurel tree, symbolizing victory and honor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Laurentian is of Latin origin, derived from the laurel tree, which symbolizes victory, honor, and achievement. In Christian tradition, the name Laurentian is associated with Saint Lawrence, a 3rd-century martyr who was known for his bravery and devotion to his faith. The name Laurentian conveys a sense of strength, courage, and spiritual resilience. It is often bestowed upon children born into Christian families who value the rich history and symbolism behind the name.

data.cultural_impact: The name Laurentian holds a rich cultural heritage as it was widely used among Christians in the Middle Ages. It is associated with the figure of Saint Lawrence, who was a deacon in Rome during the 3rd century. According to legend, when the Roman prefect ordered that all the treasures of the Church be handed over, Lawrence presented the poor, sick, and needy as the true treasures of the Church. He was then ordered to be roasted to death on a gridiron, and when he was miraculously not harmed, he reportedly joked that he was being well-cooked on both sides. His name and story continue to inspire many religious institutions, like the Laurentian Library in Florence and the University of Toronto's Laurentian campus.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Laurentian holds deep spiritual meaning as it is a reminder of the great bishop and martyr, Saint Lawrence. He exemplified the selflessness and dedication of a faithful servant of God. The legend of his jesting about being 'well-cooked' on the gridiron highlights his unwavering faith, even in the face of persecution. Today, the name inspires devotion and encourages people to mirror Saint Lawrence's unwavering faith and selflessness in their own lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: As a name associated with Saint Saint Lawrence, it represents holiness, devotion, and Christian virtue.
